thread:
maria: heads up — apiserver 5xx spike in eu-west1 starting ~08:12 UTC, correlating with etcd fsync latency spike. dashboards: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/CP/apiserver-etcd
kevin: seeing ~40% of requests hitting 500s, tail latency > 2s. kube-apiserver logs show etcd timeout errors and client retries :grimacing:
arjun: digging into etcd, leader node vm shows heavy iowait. compact/job ran at 08:10 and snapshotting started, looks like compaction+snapshot overlap. journal excerpt:
```
Aug 18 08:10:12 etcd[1]: compaction start: rev=4639123
Aug 18 08:10:12 etcd[1]: snapshot save start
Aug 18 08:11:03 kernel: EXT4-fs error (device nvme0n1): ext4_journal_start_sb: Detected aborted journal
```
maria: that lines up with GPU provisioning backoffs — autoscaler queues in front of nodepools, pods stuck Pending because apiserver won't respond to new Node registration requests
joan: any quick mitigation? can we reduce compaction frequency or pause snapshot?
kevin: short term: move snapshot target from shared HDD pool to dedicated fast-ssd, and increase etcd-cpu affinity to avoid contending IO. I'll kick off a snapshot-target-change job. patch: `etcdctl snapshot save --data-dir=/mnt/fast-ssd`
arjun: also recommend bumping etcd WAL sync settings to reduce fsync churn and stagger compaction cron across leaders. Long term: add a read-only etcd proxy for list/watch traffic and separate snapshot host for backups
sre-oncall-bot: Incident CP-1865 created by kevin (severity: high) — apiserver timeouts & GPU provisioning failures in eu-west1. Pager duty: @maria @kevin @arjun
maria: applying temp retry-policy on autoscaler to avoid thundering node requests, setting backoff to 30s. Also disabling a noisy controller that does bulk list on nodes (internal feature-flag)
kevin: snapshot target moved. Watching iowait CPU/IO. initial telemetry shows fsync latency dropping, apiserver error rate falling from 42% -> 12% over 6m :+1:
joan: cost note — moving snapshots to fast-ssd increases backup cost ~0.6% but keeps GPU jobs alive. flagging for finance review; will include in incident postmortem
arjun: still seeing occasional leader-election churn for controller-manager, suggest extending lease-duration from 15s -> 30s and renewalDeadline -> 20s, and add jitter. Will open PR to k8s-config repo
maria: temporary scaling: spun up an extra apiserver replica in eu-west1 to absorb bursts. keeping route weight 10% for canary traffic to avoid cascades
kevin: follow-up tasks: 1) stagger compaction windows 2) provision dedicated snapshot ssd pool 3) PR for controller-manager lease tuning 4) run nodepool drain tests after apiserver stable
joan: noted. I'll draft postmortem skeleton and cost delta section. thanks everyone — keep updates short here, we'll transition to incident channel if status escalates
kevin: status update (08:42): error rate stable ~3%, GPU queue draining slowly, provisioning retries succeeding. closing immediate mitigation window. will keep watches until 12:00 UTC
devops-bot: scheduled runbook task completed: moved snapshots -> fast-ssd at 08:16 UTC.
summary: Apiserver timeouts and etcd IO spike in eu-west1 caused GPU provisioning failures; short-term mitigations applied (move snapshots, extra apiserver, backoff, disable noisy controller); follow-ups: compaction staggering, dedicated snapshot storage, controller-manager lease tuning, postmortem & cost review
